kind: Read-only API and ownership review; implementation handoff, not an active plan
conclusion: Proceed first with existing XLSX cell and whole merged-range locations. No XLSX parser or Rust expansion is needed for this target. DOCX source-position production/validation can proceed independently, but its UI feedback cannot start from block-N/story-N. Keep arbitrary workbook rectangles and DOCX text/run/cell ranges outside the minimal first increment and explicitly unfinished.

confirmedEntrypoints.fact: Sheet id comes from the actual workbook sheet r:id and is resolved against its worksheet relationship. File version plus this id identifies the sheet; name/index alone cannot.
WorkbookPosition separates displayed row/column from original merge bounds and hiddenAnchor. The view has an exact bounded window.positions list.
Existing detail selection is a real WorkbookPosition. Selection currently resets on window/hidden changes; this is the place for a separate explicit feedback action.
compatible returns original selected Choice/Fallback child node objects. A source map indexed before compatibility/filtering can retain their actual XML ancestor path.
Supported paragraph/table branches still have their original DocxXml node and ctx.source part; this is where source metadata must be emitted.
Worker response uses closed block/story key sets. New source fields must be explicitly checked before reaching the DOM; changing types/parser alone will fail this boundary.
BlockSequence mounts a limited segment, Paragraph slices runs, and Table has a separate clipped view. UI segment/page numbers cannot become document source coordinates.

exclusiveFiles: src/runtime/office_feedback_target.ts (new shared callback types and dispatcher)
ownershipProposal.notes: Own the union/parser/formatter insertion once for both formats. drafts.ts already uses FileFeedbackAnchor and normally needs no production change; retain existing unsent snapshot v1 and take behavior. Do not have the DOCX parser owner also edit the union.

Use current loaded/capture/operation ownership and existing Grid detail. Add explicit cell/merged-range action; availability belongs to the actual current window and selected WorkbookPosition. No parser/source field work is required for XLSX.

ownershipProposal.ownerRole: DOCX source-position prerequisite owner, parallel with XLSX
ownershipProposal.notes: Retain original part and bounded element-child path on supported blocks; add closed Worker validation and real worker fixture proof. docx_xml.ts need not change if the source map is built on cached part roots. Coordinate signature/type changes once before others consume them.

One shared Office availability/confirmation route; same file/version/thread checks, actual ready capture and current child owner, no replacement operation. Retained drafts and explicit whole-file retarget follow P21 text semantics. Keep OpenedFileView below 1500 lines; current inspected count1207.

ownershipProposal.ownerRole: DOCX component follow-up, after prerequisite DTO freezes
ownershipProposal.notes: Reuse the same parent contract after source metadata passes Worker validation. May be assigned to the XLSX component owner sequentially to avoid shared parent/type collisions. First only whole paragraph/table targets actually mounted.

anchors.XlsxRangeAnchor: {kind:'xlsx-range'; sheetId:string; sheetName:string; fromRow:number; toRow:number; fromColumn:number; toColumn:number}

transientTypes.WorkbookFeedbackSource: Opaque live factory object retaining exact file, successful preview/sheet and current window references. Construct using actual capture.file + parsed preview; retain no copied capture body. Recreate when sheet/window/showHidden changes.
transientTypes.DocumentFeedbackSource: Opaque live factory object retaining exact successful DocxPreview and currently mounted source-backed supported block reference. A notice block cannot produce it.

runtimeFunctions: createWorkbookFeedbackSource(capture, preview, window, showHidden, expectedFile): WorkbookFeedbackSource|null; caller supplies only current successful objects
workbookFeedbackTarget(source, position:WorkbookPosition): XlsxRangeAnchor|null; position must belong by reference to current window.positions; validate selected sheet and original merge membership
officeFeedbackTargetMatches(target:OfficeFeedbackTarget): boolean; checks coordinates against its live source, not source freshness or parent ownership
createDocumentFeedbackSource(preview, block): DocumentFeedbackSource|null; only a real parsed source-backed block of that preview
minimalSharedApi.parentResponsibility: Tag withdrawal with retiring source. Confirm requires same registered source object, current thread/selection identity, same seven file fields/version, current child readiness/active/attempt and no in-flight replacement. A shape-valid anchor is never a current read receipt. Merely selecting a cell/block never mutates opinion target.

xlsxDetails.limits: Rows1..1048576, columns1..16384, ordered inclusive range; sheetName bound128 as existing parser. relationship id bound must match existing XML attribute limit rather than restrict to rId followed by digits. Persist no value, formula, run or capture.
xlsxDetails.single: Use actual visible empty or present cell coordinate. Numeric0/false/empty/missing-cache display state remains unchanged.
xlsxDetails.merged: Use the exact original sheet.merges object, not clipped WorkbookPosition.row/column or visible spans. hiddenAnchor forbids feedback until explicit show-hidden. A clipped merge may target its whole original range only with an explicit whole-merge label and existing partial view warning.
xlsxDetails.rectangle: Not needed for the requested first cell/merge slice. If subsequently included, require the full requested rectangle in current visible window, reject hidden gaps, define partial-merge policy explicitly; no auto-expansion or silent offscreen coverage.

docxMetadata.workerDelta: Supported DocxParagraph/DocxTable gain source:{part:string;elementPath:number[]}; source on notice is invalid. Block kind is already in the discriminant; saved anchor copies it explicitly. Optionally add DocxStory.part for exact story display, but block source remains authoritative.
docxMetadata.pathDefinition: Zero-based index among actual XML element children, beginning at the parsed part root. The root itself is []; body/header/footer/note containers, ignored markers and Choice/Fallback wrappers remain in the path. XML comments/text nodes are not element children. Never derive from output order or decrement indices after filters.
docxMetadata.implementation: Build one bounded WeakMap from original node to {parent,index} when each cached part root is first read. Resolve/copy only emitted supported block paths by walking parents, O(nodes + emittedBlocks*depth). Do not copy a full path array onto every one of up to500000 raw nodes. Preserve original node identity through compatible().
docxMetadata.validation: Add closed source fields in checkedDocxDocument and call with the current capture part-name allowlist. Validate part against existing OPC rules (max1024, no absolute/traversal/backslash/percent/control forms), exact allowed captured part membership, array length at most existing depth64 and safe nonnegative indices bounded by nodes500000. Include total emitted coordinate indices/part-label budget. These are shape/membership checks, not independent reconstruction of the Worker tree; real Worker literal path tests supply the derivation proof.
docxMetadata.wholeBlockBoundary: Part/path permits whole supported paragraph/table even if its display is segmented/clipped; label that scope. Header/footer/footnote/endnote use actual part/container path; noteId is optional literal display context, never page placement. Unsupported notice or invisible block offers no action.
docxMetadata.noBackendDelta: Current VerifiedFile-bound DOCX capture already includes the source package parts. No new IPC, OS read, permission or Rust change is needed for coordinates.

specificAcceptance.case: Sheet directories with nonsequential arbitrary r:id and renamed/reordered tabs; id comes from actual parsed directory, same-path newfile with reused id invalidates old candidates.
Visible empty cell,0,false,missing formula cache; clicked clipped merge retains original full bounds; hidden anchor cannot be silently selected.
Candidate then change sheet/window/showHidden, hide/retry/refresh, or late old callback; no old coordinates saved. Pointer and real keyboard explicit actions preserve original opinion text.
Equal text paragraphs separated by ignored bookmark/proof markers; emitted paths follow original XML element ordinals, not filtered block-N.
AlternateContent chosen branch includes its wrapper path; body/header/footer and two notes with identical text yield distinct part/path; original note id remains literal.
Long paragraph split and clipped/nested table target whole supported source block only; notice/hidden/unmounted content cannot produce a live target.

Malformed future anchor/extra fields atomically reject cold snapshot; valid cold coordinates remain historical; one take preserves other drafts/attachments/pending queues and write failure does not overwrite saved original.

scopeDecisionsRetained: This record refines the existing Office proposal; it is not authorization to edit current frozen source or a second active plan.
No Office editing, formula execution, external loading, Agent changes, body ledger, automatic sending or claims of Word/Excel screen-page fidelity.
No capability is marked implemented by this design. Browser/WK native readiness and actual pointer/input-Enter behavior must be tested separately; current native P21 Enter repair is higher priority.
